ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region centrally located around the peduncle and extending to the medial lobe edges; high-intensity white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal lateral regions of both lobes, with high-frequency black speckling/mottling at the boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 60 degrees; notch depth is approximately 18% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, characterized by high-frequency peaks (2-4 pixel amplitude) and wider, shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch, curving upwards and outwards to rounded lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple isolated low-intensity circular clusters (3-10 pixel diameters) embedded within the high-intensity white fields on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular indentation/tissue loss on the superior margin of the left fluke lobe tip.
